title: AND Gate
description: Implement a 2-input AND gate: out = a & b
hint: Use the & operator: assign out = a & b;

title: OR Gate
description: Implement a 2-input OR gate: out = a | b

title: 2-to-1 Multiplexer
description: When sel=0, out=a; when sel=1, out=b
hint: Use ternary operator: assign out = sel ? b : a;

title: Full Adder
description: Implement a 1-bit full adder with carry-in (cin) and carry-out (cout). Sum = a ⊕ b ⊕ cin, Cout = (a&b) | (b&cin) | (a&cin)
hint: Sum is XOR of all inputs: a ^ b ^ cin. Cout is majority function.

title: D Flip-Flop
description: Implement a positive-edge triggered D flip-flop. Output q should update only on rising clock edge.
